title: Ring, Ring! It’s the Best Black Friday Deals on Phones
gist: Wired's roundup of early 2026 Black Friday phone deals: a rare iPhone Air discount to $1,000, record-low prices on Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 ($1,550) and Z Flip8 ($1,000), 25% off the Galaxy S26 Ultra, and the Nothing Phone (4a) Pro at $399. It also gives a short guide to carrier promotions (Mint, Verizon, T-Mobile, AT&T).

insights.claim: Black Friday phone sales started early in 2026. Wired found phones it already recommends selling below their usual prices before Black Friday itself.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Earlier promotions pull holiday demand forward and squeeze margins on handsets in Q4.
insights.locator: We see tempting Black Friday phone deals

insights.claim: Apple's iPhone Air (A19 Pro chip, 5.6 mm thick, 165 g, a single 48-MP camera, middling battery life) was cut to $1,000 from $1,100 at Best Buy. Wired notes that iPhone discounts are hard to find.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Retailer discounts on Apple's thin flagship are rare and may hint at how its sell-through is going.
insights.quote: Discounts on iPhones can be hard to find

insights.claim: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8 dropped to $1,550 from $1,900 (18%, $350 off), the lowest price Wired has seen. The phone has a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip and a 4,800-mAh silicon-carbon battery.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Record-low foldable pricing and silicon-carbon battery adoption are both signals on foldable demand and battery-chemistry trends.
insights.locator: Our top pick of the best folding phones

insights.claim: Samsung raised the Galaxy Z Flip8's price by $100 from the prior generation. The Black Friday price of $1,000 (down from $1,200) cancels that increase and takes off another $100, the lowest price the phone has had.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Samsung raised foldable list prices year over year and then discounted them away, a sign of pressure on demand at full price.
insights.quote: this discount deletes the annual $100 price bump and knocks another $100 off
insights.locator: If you prefer a compact flip phone

insights.claim: Samsung's Galaxy S26 Ultra sold for about $1,050, 25% off its $1,400 list price, and has been as low as $950 before. It is the only Samsung phone with a built-in S Pen and has a Privacy Display feature.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Repeated deep discounts on Samsung's top flagship suggest the effective selling price is well below list.

insights.claim: Other Samsung Black Friday prices: Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra at $1,750 ($350 off) and Galaxy S26 FE at $550 ($150 off).
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Samsung is discounting across its whole lineup, not just individual models.
insights.locator: Here are a couple of other Samsung phones

insights.claim: The Nothing Phone (4a) Pro fell to $399 from $499, $200 below the Google Pixel 10a. Wired prefers the Pixel 10a overall but calls the Nothing phone the better budget pick at this price.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Price cuts by challenger brands put pressure on Google's midrange Pixel.
insights.locator: While we prefer the Google Pixel 10a

insights.claim: US carriers are pushing switching incentives for Black Friday: Mint Mobile discounts, Verizon bundles, deep discounts to switch to T-Mobile, and AT&T trade-in deals. Wired says buying the phone outright and shopping separately for service usually makes more sense.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Holiday subscriber-acquisition spending by carriers is a churn and margin variable to watch in Q4 telecom results.
insights.locator: While it usually makes more sense
